statement: AMD has secured data-center AI-accelerator design wins with Meta and OpenAI, with rising customer interest in its MI400 Instinct accelerators and Venice EPYC CPUs extending into 2027 ahead of its Advancing AI 2026 event.
why: Named hyperscaler and frontier-lab customers adopting AMD Instinct signal durable merchant-GPU demand and competitive traction against Nvidia.

impact.mechanism: Hyperscaler and frontier-lab design wins convert into recurring AMD accelerator orders, expanding merchant-GPU demand and diversifying away from a single vendor.

evidence.excerpt: rising interest in AMD's MI400 AI accelerators and Venice processors extending well into 2027

confidence.basis: Single secondary source citing a Morgan Stanley note; not a primary filing.
